>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Recreates a project from a bundle produced by export_project (see
PROJbundle for the format). The imported project is always local-only: a
bundle carries no cloud remote, so linking one is a separate, deliberate
step in the project's Git tab.

The archive is the raw request body rather than a multipart upload
deliberately - a multipart form would pull in python-multipart, and the
launcher only installs requirements.txt when it creates the venv, so a new
dependency would leave every existing install failing at startup.
